title: PARAPHRASUS: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Paraphrase Detection Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalization by introducing varying amounts of easy negative samples into adversarial training data to test whether models rely on spurious correlations instead of true semantic understanding.
Adding flipped premise-hypothesis pairs to repurposed natural language inference (NLI) datasets to control for the statistical artifact where premises are typically longer than hypotheses.
